title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Arrangement on Mutual Assistance in Preservation in Arbitration Proceedings between the Courts of the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Arrangement of the Supreme People's Court on Mutual Assistance in Preservation Proceedings between the Courts of the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in Arbitration Proceedings

Fa [2019] No. 207

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Arrangement of the Supreme People's Court on Mutual Assistance in Preservation Proceedings between the Courts of the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in Arbitration Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as the "Arrangement") will come into force on October 1, 2019. For the purpose of implementing the Arrangement, notice is hereby given on the relevant issues as follows:

1. The term "arbitration" as used in this Arrangement shall be determined in accordance with the law of the requested party. According to the provisions of the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China, disputes that may be arbitrated are limited to "contractual disputes and other disputes over property rights and interests arising between citizens, legal persons, and other organizations with equal status." Accordingly, the term "Hong Kong arbitration proceedings" as used in this Arrangement does not include investment arbitration between investors and host countries or regions.

2. In accordance with Article 2 of this Arrangement, the list of arbitration institutions or permanent offices shall be provided by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to the Supreme People's Court and confirmed by both parties. As of now, the following institutions or permanent offices are included: Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre, China International Economic and Trade Arbitration Commission Hong Kong Arbitration Center, International Chamber of Commerce International Court of Arbitration Asia Office, Hong Kong Maritime Arbitration Group, South China (Hong Kong) International Arbitration Court, and eBRAM International Online Dispute Resolution Centre.

3. In accordance with Article 3(2) and Article 4(1)(4) of this Arrangement, the relevant institution or permanent office shall issue a forwarding letter or a certificate letter. In practice, the forwarding letter or certificate letter issued by such institution or permanent office may be submitted by the parties to the Mainland People's Court. After receiving it, the Mainland People's Court may verify the relevant information with the contact person of the institution or permanent office (contact information attached).

4. Regardless of whether the arbitration proceedings commenced before the effective date of this Arrangement, any application for preservation filed on or after the date of entry into force of this Arrangement shall be governed by this Arrangement.

All localities shall pay attention to summarizing experience in implementing the Arrangement. In the event of new circumstances or new problems, they shall report to higher authorities level by level.

Notice is hereby given.

September 26, 2019
